RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for  ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  the April 28, 2008/Vaisakha 8, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Food Processing Industries; Human Resource Development; Law
and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and Renewable Energy; Power;
Social Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs; Women and Child
Development)
Total number of questions — 20
153
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Women empowerment
†*481. SHRI JANESHWAR
MISHRA: Will the Minister of WOMEN
AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a report
prepared recently by London School of
Oriental & African Studies, has indicated
about the negligence towards and poor
condition of women;
(b) if so, whether the so called women
empowerment is proving to be deceptive,
with half of the population of the country;
(c) if so, whether Government is
formulating any effective scheme to enable
women to get rid of these basic problems;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Enlistment of OBCs
*482. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of SOCIAL  JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a proposal under
active consideration of the Central
Government to enlist Other Backward
Classes (OBCs), besides Scheduled Castes/
Scheduled Tribes;
(b) if so, whether there is a demand to
form a Third Schedule for OBCs and
Vimukti Jati and Nomadic Tribes (VJNT);
(c) if so, whether Government has
taken/proposes to take steps in view of
the said demand; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Implementation of Rural
Electrification Scheme
*483. SHRI HARISH RAWA T:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Central Government has
recently asked the State Governments to
provide necessary support to expedite
implementation of the Rural Electrification
Scheme;

154
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether some State Governments
are not implementing the Scheme in an
effective way, as a result of which people
in rural areas are facing problems; and
(d) if so, the steps contemplated by
Government to ensure proper
implementation  of the Scheme across the
country?
Purchase of additional power during
peak hours
†*484. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that additional
power during the peak hours is being
purchased by various States of the country
at the rate of seven rupees per unit;
(b) if not, the facts in that regard;
(c) whether it is also a fact that this
power is generally sold at the rate of
Rs. 2.50 to Rs. 3.50 per unit;
(d) if not, the facts in that regard;
(e) whether the average cost of power
generation in the country is less than its
sale price; and
(f) if so, what is the average cost of
power generation?
IIIT and IIITA in Gujarat
*485. SHRI VIJAYKUMAR RUPANI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Planning Commission
has recommended the setting up of the
Indian Institute of Information Technology
(IIIT) and the Indian Institute of
Information Technology Academy (IIITA)
in Gujarat;
(b) if so, by when these institutes would
be established; and
(c) what would be the contribution of
the State and the Central Government for
these institutes?
Policy for minimum use of renewable
energy
*486. SHRI T.T.V . DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of NEW AND
RENEWABLE ENERGY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is no
policy for compulsory use of minimum
quantity of renewable energy;
(b) if so, whether Government proposes
to frame such a policy;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Expenditure on higher education
*487. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the share of
the Central Government in investment/
expenditure on higher education is
abysmally low, i.e. less than one per cent
of the total investment/expenditure;
(b) if so, the details thereof during the
last five years and the reasons therefor;
and
(c) the steps proposed to be taken by
the Central Government in this regard?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

155
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Projects for generation of solar
energy
*488. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of NEW AND
RENEWABLE ENERGY be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the projects for
generation of solar energy in the country,
State-wise;
(b) the volume of energy generated from
this source during the last three years, year-
wise;
(c) whether the Ministry has any plans
to increase the generation; and
(d) if so, the details of the plans for
enhancing the generation of solar energy?
Implementation of OBC quota
*489. DR. EJAZ ALI: Will the Minister
of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is going to
implement the 27 per cent reservation for
OBCs in higher educational institutions,
including IIMs and IITs, during 2008-09,
after the Supreme Court's verdict;
(b) whether Government is going to
increase the income range of creamy layer,
currently put at Rs. 2.5 lakhs;
(c) if so, what would be the revised limit;
and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Losses of SEBs
†*490. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARW AL: W ill the Minister of
POWER be pleased to state:
(a) the annual losses being suffered by
the State Electricity Boards (SEBs), as on
date;
(b) the present consumption of power
in the States and the quantum of power
generated by them through their own
resources;
(c) the details of the sectors from where
the remaining power is supplied; and
(d) the efforts being made by the State
Governments to acheive self-reliance in
power generation and the contribution of
the Central Government therein?
NTPC's bid for UMPPs
*491. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether the National Thermal Power
Corporation  (NTPC), with its excellent
record of successful start-ups and efficient
operations of some major thermal power
plants in the country, has not bagged even
a single bid for Ultra Mega Power Projects
(UMPPs) so far;
(b) whether the reason for NTPC losing
out to private bidders for UMPPs is
distortion in equity norms, to the
disadvantage of an ethical entity like NTPC;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Atrocities against women
*492. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND
CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of cases of atrocities
against women registered during the last
there years, State-wise and year-wise; and
(b) what is the present status of those
cases?

156
Allocation of funds
*493. SHRI PRAVEEN
RASHTRAPAL: W ill the Minister of
SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) what is the total fund made available
to the Ministry in the Budget for 2008-09;
(b) the details of funds for SCs, OBCs,
minorities, disabled, women and other
vulnerable sections, section-wise; and
(c) whether the Ministry would be able
to help all the above sections with the
amount allocated by the Ministry of
Finance?
Subsidies to power sector given by
State Governments
*494. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
SHRI RAHUL BAJAJ:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state the total amount of direct and
indirect subsidies being provided by various
State Governments due to uneconomical
power tariffs and to which sector?
Raising the age of superannuation of
Chancellors
†*495. SHRI  SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that permission
was given to raise the age of superannuation
of Chancellors of some universities;
(b) whether it is also a fact that this
opportunity was not given to the
Chancellor of Mahatma Gandhi
Antarrashtriya Hindi Vishwavidyalaya at
Wardha;
(c) whether the Chancellor had sent an
application to the Hon'ble President;
(d) whether due to this episode, there is
dissatisfaction in the Hindi world; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Posts of PGT (Sanskrit) in Kendriya
Vidyalayas
†*496. SHRI RAJNITI PRASAD: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether there are no posts of PGT
(Sanskrit) in Kendriya Vidyalayas;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether absence of the posts of PGT
(Sanskrit) or Sanskrit as a subject at senior
secondary level classes amounts to
dishonour to Sanskrit;
(d) whether Government proposes to
provide equal opportunities in promotions
to the highly qualified Sanskrit teachers,
to obviate their bleak future prospects;
and
(e) whether Government would
consider to promote highly qualified
TGT (Sanskrit) teachers, who also have
post-graduate degrees in Hindi, as PGT
(Hindi)?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

157
Deaths of children
*497. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of WOMEN
AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the death
rate of children in the country is increasing,
inspite of all the preventive measures taken
by Government, especially in the Tribal
sub-plan area of Orissa; and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and the
steps taken by Government?
Supply of coal for power plants
†*498. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the supply
of coal is not being made as per the demand
for coal-based power generation in the
country;
(b) if so, the monthly requirement of
coal and actual supply thereof; and
(c) the reasons for not supplying coal
from the indigenous resources as per the
demand, to the power generation sector?
Implementation of ICDS
*499. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND
CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Ministry
is implementing the Integrated Child
Development Scheme, which provides
supplementary nutrition and health
services to the children and lactating
mothers, through the vast network of
Anganwadis throughout the country;
(b) if so, the details  of the Scheme and
its implementation, particularly in Andhra
Pradesh;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
Anganwadi Workers are not properly
implementing the objectives of the Scheme,
including the supply of meals to children;
and
(d) if so, what action the Ministry is
taking or proposes to take, to implement
the Scheme in letter and spirit?
Webcast  of answer sheets of toppers
in CBSE
†*500. SHRI JABIR HUSAIN: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Central
Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has
arranged to show answer sheets of those
students who stand first in  10th and 12th
exams on its website; and
(b) if so, what is the plan to make this
facility available to the students of schools
located in rural areas, where internet facility
is not available?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 22nd April, 2008 Secretary-General.
V aisakha 2, 1930 (Saka)

I N D E X
